newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: ATHLETICS-GEBRSELASSIE SLIGHTLY HURT IN CAR CRASH.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-GEBRSELASSIE SLIGHTLY HURT IN CAR CRASH.

text.p: World 10,000 metres champion Haile Gebrselassie was back in training on Friday after sustaining a slight injury on Thursday night in the Ethiopian capital, state radio said on Friday.

The radio said Gebrselassie had been returning home from Addis Ababa airport when his car was involved in an accident. Gebrselassie, sitting in the passenger's seat in the front of the vehicle, hit his head on the windscreen.
"His injury was just a scratch on his forehead. Gabrselassie was at the training ground on Friday preparing himself for an event in Brussels, Belgium, in two weeks' time," the report said.
The Ethiopian destroyed his own record for the 5,000 metres in Zurich on Wednesday with a time of 12:41.86.
